messages:
lee: Heads-up: changed default kernel routing to favor low-latency paths. No API change, just server default. Deploy in morning window. Patch or minor?
tara: If users can observe perf changes it's usually minor per our semver guidance. Any opt-out?
lee: We can add REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEFAULT override and a per-deployment toggle in Dedicated.
greg: If opt-out exists + canary, I'm fine with minor. Also want a short console banner and docs.
ops-liaison: Ops ask: expose a rollout flag and add metric kernel_choice so we can alert on unexpected fallback spikes.
lee: Will add metric and env var. Canary planned for 5% traffic.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z -> 5% traffic. Rollout window 03:00-07:00Z. Auto-rollback on p95 > baseline by 20% for 5m.
tara: Proposed tags: current 2.15.0 -> bump minor to 2.16.0 and cut 2.15.x patch branch for hotfixes.
greg: Agreed. Release note blurb draft: "Default kernel selection updated to prefer latency-optimized runtimes; opt-out available via REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEFAULT."
ops-liaison: I'll prepare the banner and monitor runbook.
lee: Thanks all — will merge opt-out PR before canary and push release notes after canary passes. :thumbsup:
